name: oracle-fusion-security-assistant
description: Oracle Fusion Security & Risk Intelligence Assistant

scripts.install:subpackages: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix database
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:migrate: (npm run db:setup || echo '[DB Setup Warning] DB setup encountered an issue, starting server in resilient mode') && node index.js
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run db:provision-admin && node backend/scripts/provision_dashboard_users.cjs
